method: Built-in imagegen with true transparent background. Sharp converts the selected sources to WebP. PNG sources remain outside the repository in Codex generated_images.

assets.method: New master drawing from the canonical standing identity, then anatomy review and four animation drawings. The rejected former ultimate sheet was not an input. Uniform alpha-component packing, no non-uniform pose stretching.

steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE completely NEW game sprite, full body, on true transparent background. The supplied image is ONLY the identity, costume and anime rendering reference; invent a new pose from scratch. Hexy, this same slim pink-haired witch with navy star hat, white sailor blouse, red bow, navy pleated skirt, blue socks, black gold buckle shoes. She is suspended in the air casting a powerful spell toward the RIGHT, leaning back slightly against recoil, BOTH knees drawn up and both feet projecting forward/right. Side three-quarter view, expressive determined face, face not hidden. Her long pink hair streams left. Essential anatomy: a simple readable TWO-HANDED wand grip at chest height, elbows bent DOWN with visible space between the upper arms and forearms. Hands close together wrapping around the SAME thin black wand handle, one directly behind the other; neutral straight wrists, fingers CURL AROUND the shaft with thumbs over it; NO extended fingers, no supporting an elbow, no pointing hand, no wrist grasp, no extra limbs. Each hand visibly connects through its own forearm and elbow to its shoulder. Wand nearly horizontal pointing RIGHT, a golden five-point star at its tip, bare black slender shaft between grip and star. Make the pose visibly different from a seated girl with two straight parallel arms: the closest elbow is bent down, hands near chest, far elbow folds slightly back. Clean beautiful 2D anime game line art with soft cel shading, same head/body proportions as reference. Fully clothed, skirt drapes over hips, knees forward. No beam, glow, motion lines, clouds, labels or background. Leave transparent padding all around. This is a single new master pose, not a sheet.

Edit this NEW master pose only. Keep Hexy's whole new airborne pose, face, hat, hair, outfit and legs unchanged. Correct the TWO HANDS and wand handle: currently the lower/closest fist is below the rod and reads as holding the other wrist, which is wrong. BOTH fists must separately ENCIRCLE THE BLACK WAND SHAFT. Extend the handle leftwards, raise the lower/closest hand so its center is directly on that handle, and separate the hands along the rod by a short VISIBLE black segment about one finger-width wide. The closer hand holds the REAR part of the handle on the LEFT, the far hand holds the FRONT part on the RIGHT, both at the same shaft height, both with fingers curled down around it and thumbs over it. Neither hand may touch or overlap the other hand or wrist. Draw clear knuckles and four curled digits plus a thumb for each hand in stylized anime anatomy, natural wrist transition, nearest elbow stays bent below. The wand itself is one thin straight black shaft with its original gold star at right, no second stick. This is a small anatomical correction to the new full-body sprite, not an arm patch or a pasted hand. Preserve true transparent background and the same canvas.

Correct ONLY the arms and hands of this new airborne Hexy master sprite; keep her face, hat, hair, costume, bent knees and shoes exactly. Simplify to a CLEAR CORRECT SINGLE-HANDED wand grip. The arm CLOSEST to the viewer (from the large white sleeve at left of the chest, elbow pointing down) holds the wand alone with the hand at the LEFT end of the handle, fingers wrapped and thumb opposed, wrist naturally aligned with the forearm. DELETE the extra hand farther right along the shaft: that stretch of rod must be visibly bare. Redraw the FAR arm as bent back with its small closed free fist beside her sternum/red bow, clearly separate from the wand arm and NOT touching the wand or wrist. Both arms must have visibly understandable shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chains, with exactly TWO hands in the entire drawing: one on the wand, one free near the chest. The wand is a slender black rod pointing to the right with original gold star tip. Do not add grip loops, grips are skin directly around rod. Preserve transparent background. Prioritize simple impeccable anime anatomy over complexity. New single master sprite, no grid.

Use this corrected master sprite as the exact model for a FOUR FRAME animation sheet: 2 columns by 2 rows with EQUAL square cells on transparent background, no dividing lines or labels. Each of the 4 frames is the same full-body airborne Hexy casting toward the RIGHT with knees and feet forward. Preserve precisely the CORRECT SINGLE-HANDED grip and arm structure of the reference: closest arm and its hand wrap the wand, free far hand is a small fist near her chest below it. Absolutely NO second hand on wand, no doubled limbs. Keep face/head/hat/body proportions, navy uniform, pink hair, black shoes, outfit and slender straight wand. Each cell must contain the FULL character with generous transparent margins. Same character size and same wand star CENTER position relative to each cell across all four cells. Animate a small meaningful looping recoil/flutter: frame1 hair trails left slightly down, frame2 hair tips lift and knees draw a tiny bit closer, frame3 hair tips stream farther left with determined eyebrows, frame4 hair settles midway and shoe angles relax slightly. Forearm, wrist, fist, elbow and wand remain steady and anatomically identical in all four cells, only hair/skirt/feet soft follow-through. Match the beautiful soft anime cel shading in reference. No beam, aura, sparkles, floating marks or background. This is a game atlas, not an illustrated poster. Four clean separate sprites with good continuity, no body parts cross cell boundaries.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated complete foreground tree for the edge of an anime cartoon meadow side-scrolling game. References establish the meadow palette and line art, not a new forest biome. Draw a single elegant tall slender slightly leaning plum-brown tree trunk, with simple large readable bark shapes, a sparse compact crown of dark blue-green rounded leaves confined to the uppermost quarter, and a few low dark teal ferns at its narrow root base. Trunk middle is long and clear, just 10 percent of full tree width, with no dangling leaves, no vine tendrils, no holes or stray floating marks. Main stem visibly continuous from roots to crown. Full tree AND ALL canopy and roots completely contained in a tall portrait composition, ample transparent margin on every side, no clipping at edges. Broad clean anime ink and restrained hand painted cel shading; simplified mass shapes, not detailed realistic bark or individual tiny leaves. Dark cool foreground values, pale muted pink highlights only on very few small flowers at roots. Match reference blue-green/purple meadow colors, NO yellow forest crown. This will be scaled so the crown goes beyond the game viewport while the continuous trunk passes briefly in front. One tree, no grid or atlas, no ground strip, no sky, no full scene, no lantern or cottage, no characters, no text. True transparent background.

edit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this single complete transparent meadow tree, preserving its dark blue-green foliage, plum/purple bark, painterly anime outlines and crown/branch positions. CRITICAL: The long central lower two-thirds trunk is far too thick for a foreground game tree. REDUCE ITS WIDTH by 70 percent, to a slim graceful sapling trunk approximately 50 to 65 pixels wide on this same 1024-pixel wide image, maintaining its slightly leaning curve. The continuous long stem should never be a massive column or wide obstacle. Redraw/reshape its narrow bark naturally, do not stretch the whole image or shrink the crown. Make the root flare and low ferns narrow too: a small root base less than 200 pixels wide, no big rocks, no large plant mass. Connect the thinner trunk cleanly to the established upper branches, keep the whole tree's top and bottom positions and original image size/framing fixed. Upper branching and blue green leaf crown stay in place and stay blue green; do not make it yellow forest foliage. Keep the same natural side view, full tree contained, truly transparent background, no ground, no shadow/glow/matte, no text, no added objects.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE complete transparent foreground tree sprite for an anime cartoon forest side scrolling game. Reference is palette/style only: ochre and yellow green moss and leaves, dark teal shadows, soft storybook painted ink. CRITICAL SILHOUETTE: one VERY SLENDER long white-grey birch trunk, no twin stems, no Y fork in the lower three quarters. The long main trunk is only about 45 pixels wide on a 1024-pixel wide portrait canvas, narrowing to 30 near the crown. It is a graceful tall thin birch sapling, never a thick ancient tree or massive obstacle. This narrow stem must let most of a game character remain visible when it crosses in front. A small loosely rounded crown of broad readable yellow-green cartoon leaf clumps sits only in the uppermost 25 percent of tree height. A few short branches belong inside the crown. Root base is small/narrow, only about 150 pixels wide, with very few small mossy tufts, no big rocks and no bush that conceals the trunk bottom. Whole tree is extremely tall, slightly leaning, fully contained with 8 percent transparent margins, crown to roots continuous and intact. Long unobstructed stem through lower 75 percent. Simple bold clean hand ink outlines, broad cel-shaded paint, fewer details than reference; no photographic bark, no individual tiny leaves, no red fringes. SINGLE TREE only, one per image, portrait tall framing. No atlas/grid, no scenery background, no ground slab, no shadow/glow cloud, no text, no characters, no floating leaves, no cut branches or cropped ends. TRUE TRANSPARENT background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Animated 2D anime cartoon water VFX game atlas. FOUR sequential animation frames of river current striking a wooden bridge pillar, in strict 2 by 2 equal square cells, transparent background. Draw WATER AND FOAM ONLY, no wooden pillar: leave center of each frame empty to place the real wooden pillar over it. In every frame a low broad flattened elliptical wake of turquoise water and ivory white curved foam wraps around the base of the imagined central pillar. Small lively splashes crest on the upstream LEFT side, a wispy widening wake trails to RIGHT. Four clear progressive frames splash rises / breaks / spreads / recedes, same contact center and scale. Inked smooth cel shaded anime water, broad readable shapes, white cream foam with teal dark outlines, clean transparent alpha, no photographic particles, no gradients into black, no text/grid/checkerboard. Reference only for cartoon rendering style.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: hand-painted 2D anime platform game VERY CLOSE foreground foliage. Create one extra-wide continuous organic foreground bank of meadow grasses, bending broad leaves, small ferns, clover and a few low flowering bushes. Cinematic side-view layer, 3:1 wide image. Dark cool desaturated blue-green and plum shadows, muted teal upper leaf edges, thick organic ink outlines with soft painterly shading; simple readable foliage masses, not photorealistic. Composition CRITICAL: foliage is rooted BELOW the bottom edge, plants run OUT through bottom edge and side edges. The entire lower quarter of image must be filled with dense opaque foliage extending beyond image, upper half mostly genuinely TRANSPARENT; irregular skyline of grasses and leaves, some left taller and middle lower, no isolated clumps with visible bases. No visible soil, no pedestal, no ground shadow, no rock, no logs, no tree trunks, no rectangular base, no horizon, no background scenery. The user needs a foreground plane cropped by the viewport's lower edge like hand-drawn animation games, NOT floating cut-out objects. Tall tips at roughly 25% image height, low foliage mostly below 55%. Four visually varied connected clusters from left to right: long curved grasses, wide pointed leaves, small fern fronds, round clover bushes. No characters, no text, no sparkles. True transparent background above plants. Keep leaves drawn crisp; the game will blur this layer at runtime.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: painted 2D anime platform game VERY CLOSE foreground foliage. Create one extra-wide continuous foreground bank of riverbank sedges, curved reeds, broad willow leaves, maidenhair ferns and bushy river grasses. Cinematic side-view plane, 3:1 wide image. Dark muted olive and deep forest-green, blue-black lower shadows, restrained moss-green upper leaf edges. Strong organic ink outlines and soft cel/painterly shading, charming cartoon environment, not realistic. Composition CRITICAL: foliage roots are entirely BELOW the canvas bottom, dense vegetation runs OUT through bottom and both side edges; lower quarter entirely OPAQUE plants, above irregular tips truly TRANSPARENT. Make asymmetrical varied clusters; taller narrow reeds on right, low ferns in middle, sweeping broad leaves left. Upper half predominantly empty alpha; highest few leaf tips at 25% image height, most plants below 55%. NOT isolated objects, NOT a row of detached identical bushes. No visible bases, soil, flat slab, ground shadows, rocks, trunks, logs, water, horizon, scene background or lettering. It must look like a cropped bank of close leaves at the lens covering the bottom of a scrolling game, not stickers stuck on a dirt wall. Keep crisp painted edges for runtime blur.
